propositions: Packaged prose guides cite criterion ids inline but lack mechanical coupling to the criteria registry, allowing criterion rubrics to be rewritten while guide paraphrases silently become inaccurate.
A citation PIN manifest approach detects when a cited criterion's authoritative registry text changes by failing the gate with a named criterion and guide, forcing re-verification before re-pinning.

Citation extraction must depend only on the registry's closed criterion-id vocabulary matched at word boundaries, not on guide markup or structure, so that ordinary prose edits and restructures do not break the gate.
The pin gate must cover all guides in AUTHOR_GUIDES, run in CI by composition into validate-routing without a new workflow step, and produce an idempotent manifest packaged alongside the guides.
